heading: Leading GIS Solutions Provider in Moldova
paragraph1: Real Tech Solutions (RTS) has been a trusted technology partner since 2009. Our GeoServer platform represents the next generation of geographic information systems, specifically tailored for Moldavian businesses and organizations.
paragraph2: With over 70 custom GIS layers covering roads, terrains, utilities, cadastral data, and more, we provide comprehensive mapping solutions that power critical decision-making across various industries.
